product_overview: Flight Log Opus is a comprehensive flight management system designed for professional pilots. It offers a modern, cockpit-inspired HUD-themed interface to provide seamless management of flight logs, financial tracking, maintenance schedules, career progression, and integration with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.
core_goals: Provide pilots with an all-in-one platform to track and manage their flight logs with accuracy and ease.
Enable detailed financial management and reporting tailored for aviation professionals.
Offer maintenance tracking capabilities for aircraft with scheduling and cost control.
Integrate gamification elements including career goals and achievements to motivate pilots.
Support real-time flight tracking and mapping with a user-friendly dashboard.
Ensure data synchronization and backup with cloud support and multilingual accessibility.
Seamlessly integrate with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 for automated flight data capture.
key_features: Intelligent Dashboard showing real-time flight statistics, career summaries, goals, and achievements.
Comprehensive Flight Management with detailed logging, validation, route mapping, and statistics.
Advanced Financial System for managing revenue, expenses, customizable categories, and financial analytics.
Maintenance Tracking system including detailed records, scheduling, costs, and mechanic management.
Robust Authentication and User Profile Management ensuring security and personalization.
Multilanguage support with theme customization and notifications in advanced settings.
Real-time Maps and Flight Tracking with interactive geospatial views.
Career Progression module with rating systems and milestone tracking for pilots.
Integration with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 for automatic flight detection, telemetry, and enhanced statistics.
Backend services implemented in Express.js with WebSocket support for real-time data updates.
user_flow_summary: User registers or logs in via a secure Supabase authentication system.
Upon login, user accesses the Dashboard featuring personalized greetings and key flight statistics.
User navigates to Flight Management to add, edit, or review flight logs with automatic data validation.
Financial Management allows the user to track income, expenses, and generate financial reports.
Maintenance module lets users input maintenance events, assign mechanics, and schedule upcoming services.
The user can view real-time flight routes and tracking maps for active or past flights.
Career Progression dashboard displays rating cards and milestone progress.
Settings enable theme switching, language selection, notification preferences, and data backup options.
Integration with Microsoft Flight Simulator automates flight log entries based on telemetry data.
All user actions synchronize with backend services to maintain data integrity and real-time updates.
validation_criteria: All authentication and authorization flows must secure user data and maintain session integrity.
Flight logs must validate key parameters such as airports, aircraft details, flight duration, and routes before saving.
Financial entries should correctly categorize expenses and revenues, with reports matching backend database queries.
Maintenance records must reflect accurate scheduling and cost calculations, linked to corresponding aircraft.
Dashboard statistics and graphical data (charts, progress bars) update in real time with user data changes.
The integration with Microsoft Flight Simulator must detect and log flights automatically with accurate telemetry.
Multi-language support must render all UI text in selected languages without layout issues.
The backend WebSocket service should push real-time updates reliably to connected clients.
UI components must meet accessibility and responsiveness standards across devices and screen sizes.
